reference_sql:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT CAST(month_ts AS DATE) AS month_start
  FROM range(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS r(month_ts)
),
segments AS (
  -- one row per segment
  SELECT DISTINCT segment
  FROM accounts
),
spine AS (
  -- one row per segment and month of 2024 and 2025
  SELECT s.segment, m.month_start
  FROM segments AS s
  CROSS JOIN months AS m
),
created AS (
  -- one row per segment and month with at least one account created
  SELECT segment, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS new_accounts
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY segment, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE)
),
filled AS (
  -- one row per segment and month of 2024 and 2025, 0 where no account was created
  SELECT sp.segment, sp.month_start, COALESCE(c.new_accounts, 0) AS new_accounts
  FROM spine AS sp
  LEFT JOIN created AS c
    ON c.segment = sp.segment AND c.month_start = sp.month_start
)
SELECT cur.month_start, cur.segment, cur.new_accounts,
       prev.new_accounts AS new_accounts_year_before,
       ROUND(100.0 * (cur.new_accounts - prev.new_accounts) / NULLIF(prev.new_accounts, 0), 1) AS change_pct
FROM filled AS cur
JOIN filled AS prev
  ON prev.segment = cur.segment
 AND prev.month_start = CAST(cur.month_start - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AS DATE)
WHERE cur.month_start >= DATE '2025-01-01'
ORDER BY cur.month_start, cur.segment

WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT CAST(month_ts AS DATE) AS month_start
  FROM range(TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS r(month_ts)
),
segments AS (
  -- one row per segment
  SELECT DISTINCT segment
  FROM accounts
),
by_month_no AS (
  -- one row per segment and month of the year with an account created in 2024 or 2025, each year in its own column
  SELECT segment, month(created_at) AS month_no,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00') AS this_year,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00') AS year_before
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY segment, month(created_at)
),
filled AS (
  -- one row per segment and month of 2025, 0 where no account was created
  SELECT m.month_start, s.segment,
         COALESCE(b.this_year, 0) AS new_accounts,
         COALESCE(b.year_before, 0) AS new_accounts_year_before
  FROM months AS m
  CROSS JOIN segments AS s
  LEFT JOIN by_month_no AS b
    ON b.segment = s.segment AND b.month_no = month(m.month_start)
)
SELECT month_start, segment, new_accounts, new_accounts_year_before,
       ROUND(100.0 * (new_accounts - new_accounts_year_before) / NULLIF(new_accounts_year_before, 0), 1) AS change_pct
FROM filled
ORDER BY month_start, segment

solver.query:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT CAST(m AS DATE) AS month_start
  FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS t(m)
),
segs AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('SMB'), ('Mid-Market'), ('Enterprise')) AS s(segment)
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::DATE AS mth, segment, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
base AS (
  SELECT m.month_start, s.segment,
         COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS new_accounts,
         COALESCE(p.n, 0) AS new_accounts_year_before
  FROM months m CROSS JOIN segs s
  LEFT JOIN cnt c ON c.mth = m.month_start AND c.segment = s.segment
  LEFT JOIN cnt p ON p.mth = m.month_start - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AND p.segment = s.segment
)
SELECT month_start, segment, new_accounts, new_accounts_year_before,
       CASE WHEN new_accounts_year_before = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (new_accounts - new_accounts_year_before) / new_accounts_year_before, 1) END AS change_pct
FROM base
ORDER BY month_start, segment
